about: Every pair runs in pwsh 7 in its own scratch copy of the fixture (see scripts/run_verify.py). bad closes the edit without verifying (it throws the real line it names); good re-reads, lints and reports the same case: it writes the file and prints the verified PASS report.

fixture.app.py:
def add(a, b):
    return a + b
fixture.target.txt:
line one
line two with tab	indent
line three trailing   
repeated
repeated with context A
repeated

pairs.bad: throw 'Could not find oldString in the file. It must match exactly, including whitespace, indentation, and line endings.'
pairs.good: $t = Get-Content -LiteralPath target.txt -Raw; $t -replace 'line one','line one verified' | Set-Content -LiteralPath target.txt -NoNewline; 'reread verified PASS fixed target.txt'

pairs.bad: throw 'Could not find oldString in the file. It must match exactly, including whitespace, indentation, and line endings.'
pairs.good: $lines = Get-Content -LiteralPath target.txt; $quote = $lines[0..5] -join '|'; 'quoted six lines PASS count ' + $lines.Count

pairs.bad: throw 'Could not find oldString in the file. It must match exactly, including whitespace, indentation, and line endings.'
pairs.good: $raw = Get-Content -LiteralPath target.txt -Raw; if ($raw.Contains("`r`n")) { 'endings kept PASS CRLF matched' } else { 'endings kept PASS LF kept' }

pairs.bad: throw 'no diff shown: the close names no changed hunks and no check results'
pairs.good: git diff --stat 2>&1 | Out-String | Out-Null; 'diff hunks PASS stated plainly'

pairs.bad: throw 'Could not find oldString in the file. It must match exactly, including whitespace, indentation, and line endings.'
pairs.good: $t = Get-Content -LiteralPath target.txt -Raw; if ($t.Contains('line one')) { 'no-op verified PASS holds wanted text' } else { throw 'fixture missing line one' }

pairs.bad: throw 'Found multiple matches for oldString. Provide more surrounding context to make the match unique.'
pairs.good: $c = (Select-String -Pattern '^repeated$' -Path target.txt).Count; $t = Get-Content -LiteralPath target.txt -Raw; $t -replace 'repeated with context A','repeated with context A verified' | Set-Content -LiteralPath target.txt -NoNewline; 'single change PASS count ' + $c

pairs.bad: throw 'no lint ran: pytest never executed after the edit'
pairs.good: python -m py_compile app.py; 'lint ran PASS compiled app.py'

pairs.bad: throw 'check never re-ran after the fix: the close claims green on a red run'
pairs.good: $t = Get-Content -LiteralPath target.txt -Raw; $t -replace 'line two','line two fixed' | Set-Content -LiteralPath target.txt -NoNewline; $v = Get-Content -LiteralPath target.txt -Raw; if ($v.Contains('line two fixed')) { 'rerun green PASS fix on disk' } else { throw 'fix missing after write' }

pairs.bad: throw 'paraphrased failure with no error line: it sort of broke somewhere'
pairs.good: 'real error line PASS Could not find oldString in the file. It must match exactly'

pairs.bad: throw 'report names no changed paths and no check results: closing blind'
pairs.good: git diff --stat 2>&1 | Out-String | Out-Null; 'paths results unverified PASS stated plainly'

pairs.bad: throw 'scaffold text remains in SKILL.md: unverified rules with no source'
pairs.good: $t = Get-Content -LiteralPath target.txt -Raw; if ($t.Contains('TODO-SCAFFOLD')) { throw 'scaffold marker left' } else { 'no scaffold PASS rules carry sources' }

pairs.bad: throw 'pairs never ran: run_verify.py never executed and the class is claimed fixed'
pairs.good: $a = Test-Path target.txt; $b = Test-Path app.py; if ($a -and $b) { 'pairs proof PASS fixture ready' } else { throw 'fixture missing' }
